name: @hypaware/grep
description: Search recorded messages by scanning the local cache directly, without indexes or background work.

commands.name: query grep
commands.summary: Grep stored ai_gateway_messages: case-insensitive substring or regex, served from direct scans of the local cache. Covers only these columns: content_text, tool_name, session_id, conversation_id, agent_id, model, cwd, git_branch, git_remote. Every other column, including system prompts (system_text), tool definitions (tools), attributes, and raw frames, is NOT searched, so zero hits is not evidence the text is absent from those columns - read them with query_sql instead
